an3.17:1.1: “Bhikkhus, these three qualities lead to one’s own affliction, the affliction of others, and the affliction of both.
an3.17:1.3: Bodily misconduct, verbal misconduct, and mental misconduct.
an3.17:1.4: These three qualities lead to one’s own affliction, the affliction of others, and the affliction of both.
an3.17:2.1: “These three other qualities do not lead to one’s own affliction, the affliction of others, and the affliction of both.
an3.17:2.3: Bodily good conduct, verbal good conduct, and mental good conduct.
an3.17:2.4: These three qualities do not lead to one’s own affliction, the affliction of others, and the affliction of both.”
